test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT an economic grouping formed by different nations to strengthen their economies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**L8**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **G7** is an economic grouping consisting of seven of the world's largest advanced economies, which includes Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the United Kingdom, and the United States.
 
• **SAARC** (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation) is an organization of South Asian nations, aimed at promoting economic and regional integration.
 
• **G20** is an international forum for governments and central bank governors from 19 countries and the European Union, working to address issues related to global economic stability.
 
• **L8** is not an established economic grouping and does not exist as a recognized entity in international economic forums.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Economic groupings** are formed to foster economic cooperation, trade, and investment among member nations.
 
• Such groupings often work on reducing trade barriers, enhancing economic integration, and addressing economic challenges collectively.
 
• Examples of prominent economic groupings include the European Union (EU), the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA), and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN).
